About & Credits

About

The purpose of this website is to maintain an archive of the varied and rich stories of the Unofficial Sparkbird SMP Minecraft server. It is also helpful for people who are new on the server to understand what lore people have made. This website is made and maintained by the moderators of the Unofficial Sparkbird SMP discord server.
